en.title: Fragrant pear assortment
en.summary: Seasonal pears with a melting texture and floral aroma.
en.html:
Enjoy waiting for this assortment of pears to reach its perfect ripeness.

When to enjoy them

Check the skin and aroma. Once the fruit softens slightly, chill it and enjoy.

markdown:
食べ頃が来るのを待つ時間も楽しめる、洋梨の詰め合わせという想定です。

## 食べ頃の目安

果皮の状態と香りを確かめ、柔らかくなってきたら冷やしてどうぞ。
